<?php

const INF = 1000000001;

class Pair {
    public $first;
    public $second;
    public function __construct($first, $second) {
        $this->first = $first;
        $this->second = $second;
    }
}

function sort_arr(&$arr, $low = 0, $high = null) {
    if ($high === null) {
        $high = count($arr) - 1;
    }
    if ($low >= $high) {
        return;
    }

    $left = $low;
    $right = $high;
    $pivot = (int)(($low + $high) / 2);

    $temp = $arr[$pivot];
    $arr[$pivot] = $arr[$right];
    $arr[$right] = $temp;

    for ($i = $low; $i <= $high; $i++) {
        if ($arr[$i] < $arr[$right]) {
            $temp = $arr[$i];
            $arr[$i] = $arr[$left];
            $arr[$left] = $temp;
            $left++;
        }
    }

    $temp = $arr[$left];
    $arr[$left] = $arr[$right];
    $arr[$right] = $temp;

    sort_arr($arr, $low, $left - 1);
    sort_arr($arr, $left + 1, $high);
}

function check($n) {
    $s = 0;
    while ($n > 0) {
        $s += $n % 10;
        $n = (int)($n / 10);
    }
    return $s == 10;
}

function solution() {
    $stdin = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
    $stdout = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

    $k = 0;
    fscanf($stdin, "%d\n", $k);

    for ($i = 19; $k > 0; $i++) {
        if (check($i)) {
            $k--;
        }
        if ($k == 0) {
            fwrite($stdout, $i . "\n");
            return;
        }
    }
}

solution();
